welcome.title: Welcome to Zettel
welcome.body: Find and capture notes from anywhere: one window for search, new notes and a daily journal.
welcome.ask:
Open Zettel with %1?
This adds one line to %2.
Take it out any time with: zettel setup --remove
welcome.hint: Enter add shortcut  ·  Esc not now
setup.later: No shortcut was added. Run zettel setup in a terminal whenever you want one.
trust.title: The settings of %1 have changed
trust.body: A notebook's settings and templates can run commands on your computer, so Zettel won't use this notebook until you trust it. If you made these changes, trust it. If the notebook came through sync, git or from someone else and you didn't expect changes, look at them first.
trust.hint: Enter open settings  ·  Ctrl+Enter trust  ·  Esc not now  ·  ↑↓ scroll
trust.noDiff: Something changed, but there is nothing to show line by line, such as an empty file being added.
trust.blockedBody: You haven't trusted its settings yet. Nothing was saved, and your text is still in the window. Open Zettel again to look at the settings, or run: zettel trust %1
